band.catchingUp: Checking recent changes; the view may take a few seconds.
band.disconnected: Lost the connection to the engine. What you see may be out of date since {{time}}.
band.stopped: The GitRaptor engine is not running: no history is being recorded for your repos.
band.restricted: An agent opened this window. You see what it sees and can't make changes from here.

resync.slowConsumer: The app fell behind the engine.

incompatible.title: Incompatible engine
incompatible.daemonOlder: The running engine ({{version}}, from {{path}}) is older than this app. Update that GitRaptor installation, or stop its engine from a terminal so the app can start its own:
incompatible.daemonOlderUnknown: The running engine is older than this app. Update the GitRaptor installation that started it, or stop it with `raptor daemon stop` from that installation.
incompatible.ownEngine: The running engine is this app's own, from an older version. Start it again to update it.
incompatible.appOlder: This app is older than the running engine ({{version}}). Update the app.
incompatible.noCommand: The engine's path has characters that can't be copied safely; stop it from the installation that started it.

rejected.title: Engine channel refused
rejected.message: The GitRaptor runtime folder is not private → check that only your user can open it.

unsupported.title: No engine channel
unsupported.message: This platform has no engine channel yet.

restricted.title: Restricted view
restricted.message: This window shows no repos because an agent opened it. Open GitRaptor yourself to see your fleet.

waitingForGit.title: Waiting for Git
waitingForGit.message: Git {{min}} or later not found → install or update it; the engine starts on its own once it finds it.

step1.body: What each agent does, on which branch, and which changes will clash before they do.

step2.title: Recover what went wrong
step2.body: GitRaptor keeps restore points. One button takes you back.

step3.title: Stop what's dangerous
step3.body: If an agent tries to delete or rewrite your main branch, it's stopped and explained.
